candidate_relations.reason: The clinical weakness resembles anterior interosseous neuropathy, but EMG abnormalities also involve biceps, triceps, and deltoid muscles, supporting multifocal neuralgic amyotrophy (Parsonage-Turner syndrome) rather than an isolated anterior interosseous nerve syndrome.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Anterior interosseous nerve dysfunction is a focal manifestation of the broader brachial neuritis syndrome.
